K.description: Convolution kernel size / cached window length (conv_L_cache).

description: LFM2-MoE decode-path depthwise causal conv1d update (kernel_size=3, no activation). The conv_state input holds the full K-wide window and is rolled/updated in place.
name: lfm2_moe_causal_conv1d_update
reference:
# Source: https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/blob/5eddc12edfaf8cafde8c9bae4ccb12f8a139b4f9/src/transformers/models/lfm2_moe/modeling_lfm2_moe.py#L365-L382
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F

def run(x, conv_state, weight, bias=None, activation=None):
    # `conv_state` holds the full K-wide window and is rolled in place.
    # LFM2 short-conv fuses no activation, so `activation` is always None.
    _, hidden_size, seq_len = x.shape
    state_len = conv_state.shape[-1]
    hidden_states_new = torch.cat([conv_state, x], dim=-1).to(weight.dtype)
    conv_state.copy_(hidden_states_new[:, :, -state_len:])
    out = F.conv1d(hidden_states_new, weight.unsqueeze(1), bias, padding=0, groups=hidden_size)
    return out[:, :, -seq_len:].to(x.dtype)
